quote.tekst: We still need to rise nine more steps to get to 10.
quote.wie: Bang Chan (Stray Kids), interview met Rolling Stone (2025)

items.titel: Stray Kids: extra concerten in Seoul
items.sub: 1 en 2 jan 2027 in Gocheok Sky Dome, onderdeel van RUN IT
stadiontour door Azië, Amerika en Europa, ook Arnhem
TXT, Yeonjun (ook presentator), Stray Kids en EVAN

nummer.over: Boygroup uit 2018. Slotstuk van hun 'Treasure'-reeks, waarin de schat staat voor je dromen: een krachtig nummer over samen door het donker heen vechten voor je eigen wereld.

quotes: Je hoeft niet perfect te zijn om te schitteren. Gewoon jezelf is al genoeg licht.
I want to hear your voice, and I want to hear your conviction.
We have learned to love ourselves, so now I urge you to 'speak yourself.'
I have also learned that I should try to love myself a bit more.
We're grateful that we are still doing shows and people come to see us and we're proud to have come this far.
I'm always trying really hard to show the best version of myself when I'm performing.
We're a group, so that's how we work. Together.
I think I'll keep exploring different sides of myself rather than trying to fit into one label.
I have learnt that I am nothing without the Kids.
I never really thought that I was good at singing or rap or dancing. It's something that I practiced.
I thank a lot of people, not only around me, but also fans globally for helping me learn to love myself.
We're determined to challenge ourselves and push boundaries.
I wanted people to see me exactly as I am.
I still feel nervous, shaky, hopeful, and excited for the stage.
Seeing how people connect with my music in their own way made everything feel worth it.
I think that in order to not fall behind, I have to keep working hard.
I hope this song reminds people that it's okay to keep going at their own pace.
The fact that all five members are always together to this day seems like a miracle to me.
But them showing me love teaches me that I can be more confident in myself.
To me, it's about believing in yourself and continuing to move forward.
We want to continue to express our honest thoughts and relate to one another through our music.
I will never take anything for granted and keep on doing my best.
If we make mistakes, we grow together.
Even if we're unsure if we can pull it off, we can if we just go for it.
There is always a safe choice, but the reason we do experimental things is because it's more fun.
It's the small efforts I've built up, day by day, that have brought me to where I am now.
We still have that same heat and passion for the stage.
As time goes by, I think the chemistry between our seven just gets better.
As I continue making music, I think I'll find the version of myself that is most true to who I am.
I'm talking about me becoming a better person who goes further as a human being.
Because we've been together for so long, we understand each other.
I just tried to make something that really feels like me, and I hope that comes through.
I want us to be remembered as a group that can pull off any concept.
Thanks to them, I am able to keep my freckles.
Each member, with their own difference, can put their own style inside of their own lines.
I can't believe the moment I've been dreaming of is finally coming true.
I don't have any regrets because I'm doing the job I want to.
I hope that one day Stray Kids will become a genre itself.
We want to keep doing things our own way and establish our own signature sound.
We still need to rise nine more steps to get to 10.
